name: guardrails
description: Guardrail hooks for Claude Code (git staging guard, SQL guard, session-start marker, pre-compaction handoff, project formatter), a plan → implement → verify → crosscheck delivery loop, a /critical-review exit gate with a pluggable read-only reviewer (Codex, Claude or your own command), doc-tiering commands, a terse output style, and a fleet sync with drift audit.
